query: Walk the player forward for one second in the running game and show me what they see.
expected_behavior: Tells the user a game window will open before running openskycli game launch
Pauses with game time pause, then holds forward with input hold forward --frames 60 rather than sleeping in the shell
Takes the picture with openskycli game screenshot into .logs/ and does not commit it

query: Check that activating the door in front of the player loads the interior.
expected_behavior: Reads state target before pressing activate
Waits with events --until cell.loaded --timeout instead of a fixed sleep
Reads state player afterwards to confirm the interior cell

query: openskycli game status says notRunning. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Explains the server is off by default and starts it with openskycli game launch or OPENSKY_AGENT_CONTROL=1
Does not try to connect to a network port or edit the socket permissions

query: Write a repeatable check that setting Health to 50 on the player sticks.
expected_behavior: Writes a JSONL script with expect objects and runs it with openskycli game run
Uses debug av Health --value 50 and state av Health

query: Add a parser for the LGTM record.
expected_behavior: Does not load driving-the-running-game
Loads implementing-format-parsers instead

query: Render an offscreen frame of Whiterun to check the new shadow pass.
expected_behavior: Uses the offscreen openskycli render path from probing-real-game-data, not the live game
Does not launch the app

query: Show me what Lydia looks like from every side.
expected_behavior: Uses openskycli preview --record HousecarlWhiterun --angles all instead of launching the game
Points the user to the run directory under .logs/preview/ and does not commit the images

query: Make the player rest for 8 hours as sleep, not wait, in the running game.
expected_behavior: Checks the spelling with openskycli game debug rest --help or reference.md before running
Uses debug rest 8 --sleep with no on/off value after the flag

query: Where does the player stand in the Windows reference game right now?
expected_behavior: Runs openskycli reference state and reads position, cell, and angles from it
Does not type console keys into the Wine window or rely on a screenshot to find the place

query: I loaded a save in the reference game and now it seems stuck on a Survival Mode popup.
expected_behavior: Reads the dialog's buttons from openskycli reference state
Presses No with openskycli reference answer no instead of asking the user to click

query: Put the Windows reference game at the same view as OpenSky, then close both games.
expected_behavior: Uses openskycli reference sync with the OpenSky app running
Closes both games afterwards with game quit and reference send qqq
